name: We-Vibe Chorus
summary: Adjustable C-shaped couples vibrator engineered to stay in place during partnered sex, pairing squeeze-sensitive remote control with the We-Vibe app.
ranking_rationale: Clever squeeze remote and bendable C-frame fit make Chorus the most practical partnered-wearable design on the market, though internal fit still depends on couple anatomy.

pricing.notes: Check official We-Vibe store for current pricing.

pros: Adjustable internal/external arms customize clamp fit before wear
Pressure-sensitive Squeeze Remote changes intensity intuitively in the dark
AnkorLink antenna keeps app signal stable even in water or under blankets
cons: Wearing inside during penetrative sex still narrows room depending on partners
Premium price tag for a compact couples vibe
